headline: Argentine Equities Fall on Global Sell-off While Sovereign Bonds Gain Ground
summary: Argentine American Depositary Receipts declined tracking global equities, while local sovereign bonds gained 0.2%, trimming country risk to 848 basis points as the dollar reached $1,580.
why: Argentina's financial markets reflect sovereign default spreads, central bank reserves, and exchange rate volatility.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: The US dollar rose against the peso as local equity listings followed global stock markets down.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: International equity declines weighed on Argentine ADRs, while domestic bond demand lowered sovereign risk indicators.
